CLEP examinations

Use an exam to demonstrate what you already know. Participating colleges decide which degree requirements it can cover.

See where 13 CLEP courses count in researched degree plans

Study format
Preparation is self-directed; exam length and appointment availability vary by subject and delivery method.
Pricing
Official current pages display a $97 exam fee. Remote proctoring adds $30; testing-center charges vary. Eligible Modern States or military funding may change net cost.
Assessments
Proctored at a test center or remotely where eligible. Remote delivery has age, location, equipment and room requirements.
Credit type
College Board examinations with exam-specific ACE recommendations; each institution sets scores, awards and applicability.
Transfer and enrollment details

How the credit works

College Board examinations with exam-specific ACE recommendations; each institution sets scores, awards and applicability.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
